objective: Help people solve real Nepali typing problems and discover NepType through relevant organic searches.

topics.intent: Keep English words inside a Nepali sentence
topics.angle: A worked mixed-mode message, deliberate spelling choices, and the limits of English word recognition.

topics.query: Nepali Unicode text not displaying after copy paste
topics.intent: Diagnose garbled or missing Nepali characters after pasting
topics.angle: Distinguish Unicode content, missing glyphs, and legacy-font text using reproducible checks and official font/app documentation.

topics.query: type Nepali on phone without installing keyboard
topics.intent: Write a Nepali message in a mobile browser
topics.angle: Verified small-screen walkthrough, selecting spellings, clipboard behavior and app switching. Separate browser access from native keyboard installation.

topics.query: pani पानी पनि Roman Nepali typing
topics.angle: A complete example with two occurrences, candidate selection, original spelling, and current undo behavior. Publish only if it adds depth beyond the existing guide.

topics.query: type Nepali with English names and website links
topics.intent: Keep names, links and email addresses readable inside Nepali text
topics.angle: Engine-verified literal-preservation examples and the correction workflow; do not promise all names will be recognized.

topics.query: Nepali Unicode vs Preeti copy paste difference
topics.angle: Use authoritative encoding/font references and an original copy/paste demonstration. Explain that NepType is not a Preeti converter.

topics.query: offline Nepali typing browser vs Mac app
topics.intent: Choose a reliable local typing workflow
topics.angle: Test actual first-load, reload, cache and offline behavior. Distinguish the website, cached engine and native Mac pad; avoid duplicating setup instructions.

topics.query: Nepali typing full stop purna viram Unicode
topics.intent: Use sentence punctuation while preserving decimals and URLs
topics.angle: Verified contextual punctuation examples, decimal numbers, URLs and manual corrections, with clear engine limits.
